Class ActivityMonitor

java.lang.Object
com.example.ActivityMonitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
TelemetryObserver
public class ActivityMonitor extends Object implements TelemetryObserver
Author:
Ubayd Razack Turns snapshots of the open editors into EventType.EDIT, EventType.IDLE_START and EventType.IDLE_END events.

      public void onEvent(TelemetryEvent event)

    • poll

      public void poll(Map<String,Integer> textLengths)
      Checks the open editors for changes and for idleness. Publishes an EventType.EDIT for each editor whose length changed since the last poll, and an EventType.IDLE_START once the idle threshold has passed. An editor seen for the first time only sets a starting point.
      Parameters:
      textLengths - each open editor's current text length, by class name
